WITH
P AS (
-- scope: products in department DP-48, latest version, product filters
SELECT product, total_brand, division, group_id, department, class, subclass, style, stylecolor FROM trd_stylecolor_hier_attr
WHERE department = 'DP-48' 
ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY product
),
L AS (
-- scope: locations in channel CH-2, location filters
SELECT location, channel, selling_channel, area, region, district FROM trd_store_hier_attr
WHERE channel = 'CH-2' 
ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY location
),
W_selected AS (
-- weeks: selected window (2025_W37 .. 2025_W40, 4 weeks)
SELECT arrayJoin(['2025_W37', '2025_W38', '2025_W39', '2025_W40']) AS wk
),
W_receipt AS (
-- weeks: receipt window (2025_W37 .. 2025_W40, 4 weeks)
SELECT arrayJoin(['2025_W37', '2025_W38', '2025_W39', '2025_W40']) AS wk
),
pop_flow AS (
-- population rule HIST_STD.flow [TY] v1 (draft): item flows: averages over the receipt window
SELECT stylecolor AS item FROM trd_sku_temp_flow_flag
WHERE stylecolor IN (SELECT product FROM P) AND time IN (SELECT wk FROM W_receipt)
GROUP BY stylecolor
HAVING avg(dmd_u) > 10 OR avg(shp_u) > 10 OR avg(eoh_u) > 5
),
pop_hist AS (
-- population rule HIST_STD.hist [TY] v1 (draft): item sold or held stock in the selected weeks (price-status filter applies)
SELECT product AS item FROM trd_p_history_agg
WHERE product IN (SELECT product FROM P) AND time IN (SELECT wk FROM W_selected) AND prodlife IN ('FP', 'MD') AND cluster IN ('A', 'AA', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'NA', 'WEB')
GROUP BY product
HAVING sum(dmd_u) > 10 OR sum(shp_u) > 10 OR sum(eoh_u) > 5
),
pop_onorder AS (
-- population rule HIST_STD.onorder [TY] v1 (draft): open on-order keeps an item in even without history (full price only)
SELECT DISTINCT product AS item FROM trd_p_onorder_agg
WHERE product IN (SELECT product FROM P) AND (on_order_u > 0)
),
pop_flow_status AS (
-- population rule HIST_STD.flow_status [TY] v1 (draft): 0 New / 1 Carryover / 2 Sell Down
SELECT stylecolor AS item, toUInt8(multiIf(max(flow_flag) > 1000000, 0, max(flow_flag) > 0, 1, 2)) AS class FROM trd_sku_temp_flow_flag
WHERE stylecolor IN (SELECT product FROM P) AND time IN (SELECT wk FROM W_receipt) AND (rec_u >= 0)
GROUP BY stylecolor
),
Q AS (
-- population HIST_STD [TY]: flow AND (hist OR onorder)
SELECT item, class FROM pop_flow_status
WHERE (item IN (SELECT item FROM pop_flow) AND ( item IN (SELECT item FROM pop_hist) OR item IN (SELECT item FROM pop_onorder) ))
  AND class IN (0, 1, 2)
),
U AS (
-- scan history (trd_p_history_agg) TY window=selected locations=scope: cc_count, eoh_u_last, eoh_u_sum, funded_ret_u, funded_shp_u, ret_c, ret_r, ret_u, shp_c, shp_r, shp_u, strcntwk_funded
SELECT h.stylecolor AS g_stylecolor, qq.class AS class, toFloat64(uniqExactIf(a.product, (a.strcntwk > 0.000001))) AS m_cc_count, toFloat64(sumIf(a.eoh_u, a.time = (SELECT max(wk) FROM W_selected))) AS m_eoh_u_last, toFloat64(sum(a.eoh_u)) AS m_eoh_u_sum, toFloat64(sumIf(a.ret_u, (a.strcntwk_funded > 0.000001))) AS m_funded_ret_u, toFloat64(sumIf(a.shp_u, (a.strcntwk_funded > 0.000001))) AS m_funded_shp_u, toFloat64(sum(a.ret_c)) AS m_ret_c, toFloat64(sum(a.ret_r)) AS m_ret_r, toFloat64(sum(a.ret_u)) AS m_ret_u, toFloat64(sum(a.shp_c)) AS m_shp_c, toFloat64(sum(a.shp_r)) AS m_shp_r, toFloat64(sum(a.shp_u)) AS m_shp_u, toFloat64(sumIf(a.strcntwk_funded, (a.strcntwk_funded > 0.000001))) AS m_strcntwk_funded
FROM trd_p_history_agg AS a
ANY LEFT JOIN Q AS qq ON a.product = qq.item
ANY LEFT JOIN P AS h ON a.product = h.product
ANY LEFT JOIN L AS l ON a.location = l.location
WHERE a.product IN (SELECT item FROM Q) AND a.time IN (SELECT wk FROM W_selected) AND a.location IN (SELECT location FROM L) AND a.prodlife IN ('FP', 'MD') AND a.cluster IN ('A', 'AA', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'NA', 'WEB')
GROUP BY g_stylecolor, class
),
G AS (
-- metrics at grain g_stylecolor, class
SELECT g_stylecolor, class, sum(m_cc_count) AS cc_count, sum(m_eoh_u_last) AS eoh_u_last, sum(m_eoh_u_sum) AS eoh_u_sum, sum(m_funded_ret_u) AS funded_ret_u, sum(m_funded_shp_u) AS funded_shp_u, sum(m_ret_c) AS ret_c, sum(m_ret_r) AS ret_r, sum(m_ret_u) AS ret_u, sum(m_shp_c) AS shp_c, sum(m_shp_r) AS shp_r, sum(m_shp_u) AS shp_u, sum(m_strcntwk_funded) AS strcntwk_funded, cc_count AS cccount, shp_r - ret_r AS net_sls_r, shp_u - ret_u AS net_sls_u, shp_c - ret_c AS net_sls_c, net_sls_r - net_sls_c AS net_sls_margin_r, if((net_sls_r) > 0, round((net_sls_margin_r) / (net_sls_r), 4), 0) AS net_sls_margin_pct, if((strcntwk_funded) > 0, round((funded_shp_u - funded_ret_u) / (strcntwk_funded), 4), 0) AS funded_aps_u, eoh_u_last AS last_value_eoh_u, eoh_u_sum AS sum_eoh_u, if((net_sls_u) > 0, round((sum_eoh_u) / (net_sls_u), 4), 0) AS stk_sls_u
FROM U
GROUP BY g_stylecolor, class
)
SELECT g_stylecolor, class, cccount, net_sls_r, net_sls_u, net_sls_margin_pct, funded_aps_u, last_value_eoh_u, stk_sls_u
FROM G
ORDER BY g_stylecolor, class
